The 5 <c:ffff00>leg types<c> with good compatibility that each
<c:ffff00>{{medal}}<c> has.

A leg <c:ffff00>{{part}}<c> whose type matches a best {{leg_type}} gets
a boost to these <c:ffff00>{{stats}}<c>: <c:ffff00>{{mobility}}<c>, <c:ffff00>{{fighting}}<c> and
<c:ffff00>{{shooting}}<c>.

The amount depends on <c:ffff00>{{rank}}<c>: {{bronze}} +2, {{silver}} +4,
{{gold}} +6.
